استرعين (form X)
# اِسْتَرْعَيْنَ (istarʕayna) /is.tar.ʕaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
# اُسْتُرْعِينَ (usturʕīna) /us.tur.ʕiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
# اِسْتَرْعِينَ (istarʕīna) /is.tar.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
